zh.title: Anduril YFQ-44A Fury無人機摧毀目標 仍需人工批准方可發射
zh.summary: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，Anduril 開發的 YFQ-44A Fury 無人機近期在測試中摧毀目標，證實其作戰能力。然而，在美國空軍未來的相關作戰任務中，該款新式戰鬥無人機仍必須由人員進行確認與批准，方能執行發射命令。
body: 根據外媒 Simple Flying 報導，由 Anduril 開發的 YFQ-44A Fury 無人機近期在作業中成功摧毀預定目標，以此證實了該型戰鬥無人機具備相應的攻擊與任務執行能力。
然而，針對這款美國空軍的新型戰鬥無人機，未來的作戰部署與相關任務執行仍受限於防護規範。即使 YFQ-44A Fury 已證實其打擊能力，系統在沒有獲得操作人員明確批准與授權的情況下，依然無法直接進行武器發射，確保人工機制始終參與控制流程。

en.title: Anduril YFQ-44A Fury Drone Destroys Target But Still Requires Human Approval to Fire
en.summary: According to reporting by Simple Flying, Anduril's YFQ-44A Fury drone recently successfully destroyed a target, providing proof of its operational combat capability. However, despite proving what the uncrewed aircraft can achieve, human operators must remain directly in the command loop for future operations involving the US Air Force's combat drone fleet. As a result of these established operational rules, the new combat drone still cannot fire weapons without receiving explicit human authorization prior to engagement.
body: According to reporting published by Simple Flying, the YFQ-44A Fury combat drone developed by defense technology company Anduril recently destroyed a target during field tests. The trial successfully demonstrated the uncrewed aircraft's technical capability to engage and destroy targets.

Despite the successful demonstration proving what the aircraft can achieve, operational requirements for the US Air Force mandate that a human operator must remain in the decision loop during future deployments. Under these rules, the new combat drone cannot fire any weapons without receiving explicit prior approval from human personnel. The control protocol ensures human oversight remains central to all weapon firing decisions.

zh.title: 菲律賓航空接收第三架A350-1000 將飛馬尼拉-舊金山
zh.summary: 菲律賓航空於2026年7月29日從圖盧茲接收第三架A350-1000（註冊號RP-C3512），新機將於8月5日首航馬尼拉至舊金山，初期每週三班，9月轉為每日，使菲航成為東南亞唯一營運該機型的航空公司。
body: 菲律賓航空於2026年7月29日從空中巴士圖盧茲交付中心接收第三架A350-1000，註冊號為RP-C3512，抵達馬尼拉後將完成法規與運作準備。
該機型為菲航長程旗艦，配備最新商務、豪華經濟及經濟艙，且較舊機型具備更佳燃油效率、更低排放與更大貨艙容量。
新機計劃於8月5日首航馬尼拉至舊金山航線，初期每週二、五、日各一班，9月轉為每日班次。
此舉使菲律賓航空成為東南亞首家且目前唯一營運A350-1000的航空公司。

en.title: Philippine Airlines receives third A350-1000, to launch Manila–San Francisco service
en.summary: Philippine Airlines took delivery of its third Airbus A350-1000 on 29 July 2026, registration RP-C3512, arriving in Manila from Toulouse. The aircraft will debut on the Manila–San Francisco route on 5 August 2026, initially three weekly flights (Tue, Fri, Sun) before daily service in September, making PAL the first and only Southeast Asian carrier operating the A350-1000.
body: Philippine Airlines took delivery of its third Airbus A350-1000 on 29 July 2026, registration RP-C3512, arriving in Manila from Airbus’s delivery centre in Toulouse, France, where it will complete regulatory and operational preparations.

The A350-1000 serves as the carrier’s long‑haul flagship, featuring new Business, Premium Economy and Economy cabins with improved fuel efficiency, lower emissions and greater cargo capacity versus older types.

The aircraft is scheduled to enter service on the Manila–San Francisco route on 5 August 2026, initially operating three weekly flights on Tuesdays, Fridays and Sundays before moving to daily service in September 2026.
The delivery makes Philippine Airlines the first and only airline in Southeast Asia operating the A350-1000.

zh.title: 達美航空於明尼蘇達州啟用SAF摻配設施 強化明尼阿波利斯樞紐永續燃料供應
zh.summary: 達美航空與明尼蘇達州官員於7月27日共同標誌Flint Hills Resources煉油廠內一座全新永續航空燃料摻配設施完工啟用。該設施可將純SAF與傳統燃油混合後，經既有管線輸往達美第二大樞紐明尼蘇達波利斯聖保羅國際機場（MSP），預計全面運轉後每年可摻配3千萬加侖純SAF。
body: 達美航空於2026年7月27日，與明尼蘇達州政商界人士一同為Flint Hills Resources Pine Bend煉油廠內一座新設燃油摻配設施舉行完工儀式，此設施目的在於為明尼蘇達波利斯聖保羅國際機場挹注更多永續航空燃料（SAF）。
MSP為達美航空第二大樞紐，每年消耗約2.5億加侖航空燃油。達美航空與Flint Hills Resources最初於2024年9月宣布該摻配設施計劃，如今該設施允許SAF於煉油廠端直接與標準航空燃油混合，並藉由既有管線輸往機場。
一旦全面運轉，此設施預計每年可摻配最高3,000萬加侖的純SAF。SAF係以再生原料製造，可顯著降低全生命週期的碳排放，且無需修改便可直接用於現今的飛機引擎及多數機場既有的輸儲系統。
達美航空總裁Peter Carter表示，此設施是多年來共同願景的成果，目標是讓明尼蘇達在永續航空燃料領域取得領先地位，並藉由擴大基礎建設支持更廣泛的SAF採用，將潛力轉化為現實。
啟用儀式現場出席者包括達美航空總裁Peter Carter、Flint Hills Resources總裁兼執行長Francis Murphy、Ecolab代表Nick Alfano、Greater MSP代表Peter Frosch、美國參議員Amy Klobuchar、州長Tim Walz、眾議員Brad Finstad、議長Lisa Demuth及參議員Ann Rest等。
此設施屬於明尼蘇達SAF Hubs的一項里程碑，該聯盟由達美航空於2023年攜手Greater MSP Partnership、美國銀行、Ecolab與Xcel Energy共同發起。噴氣燃料約佔達美航空碳排放的90%，該公司已設定2030年使用10%SAF、並在2050年達成淨零排放的目標。

en.title: Delta Marks New SAF Blending Facility Opening at Minneapolis-St. Paul Airport Hub
en.summary: Delta Air Lines and Minnesota officials marked the completion of a new sustainable aviation fuel blending facility at Flint Hills Resources' Pine Bend Refinery on July 27, 2026. The facility allows SAF to be blended with standard jet fuel on-site and piped directly to Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport, Delta's second-largest hub, and is expected to blend up to 30 million gallons of neat SAF annually once running at full capacity.
body: Delta Air Lines gathered with Minnesota officials on July 27, 2026, to mark the completion of a new fuel blending facility at Flint Hills Resources' Pine Bend Refinery, a project intended to bring more sustainable aviation fuel to Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport (MSP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     , Delta's second-largest hub.

Sustainable aviation fuel is made from renewable feedstocks and can cut lifecycle carbon emissions significantly compared to regular jet fuel. The new facility allows SAF to be blended with standard jet fuel right at the refinery, then delivered to MSP through pipelines that are already in place.

Delta burns through roughly 250 million gallons of jet fuel a year at MSP alone. Once running at full capacity, the facility is expected to blend up to 30 million gallons of pure SAF annually. Delta and Flint Hills Resources first announced the plan back in September 2024.

Delta President Peter Carter called the facility the result of years of work toward a shared goal. "This facility is the culmination of a shared vision for Minnesota to become a leader in sustainable aviation fuel," he said. "By expanding the infrastructure needed to support broader SAF adoption, it represents an important step toward turning that potential into reality."

The opening brought out figures including Flint Hills President and CEO Francis Murphy, Ecolab's Nick Alfano, Greater MSP's Peter Frosch, US Senator Amy Klobuchar, Governor Tim Walz, Congressman Brad Finstad, Speaker Lisa Demuth, and Senator Ann Rest.

The facility is one of four milestones tied to the Minnesota SAF Hub, a coalition Delta helped launch in 2023 alongside the Greater MSP Partnership, Bank of America, Ecolab, and Xcel Energy to grow a regional SAF supply. Jet fuel accounts for around 90% of Delta's carbon emissions, and the airline has a goal of running on 10% SAF by 2030 toward net zero emissions by 2050.
